newsitem.title: LATVIA: STANDARD&POORS TO SET NEW RIGA RATING TODAY.
newsitem.headline: STANDARD&POORS TO SET NEW RIGA RATING TODAY.

text.p: Latvian capital Riga said on Friday that its new credit rating is being awarded this afternoon by Standard & Poors.
"This afternoon Standard & Poors will discuss, what rating to award Riga," Inga Cerbule, Riga city finance department deputy director for investment credit questions, told Reuters.
Riga earlier said it was awarded a BBB- long-term credit rating by Standard & Poors, but was seeking a higher one.
She said the rating results would be known on Monday.
Standard & Poor's has already rated Latvia as BBB, which is investment grade.
Riga city was disappointed with the BBB- and wanted S&P to review the rating and give them a new one.
